Question 14 Marks for correct response: 1.00 Negative marking: 0.00 Study the table and find the value of r. Marks awarded 0 Difficulty - Attempt% 58 Correct% 35 Your time 6 Avg time 131 r is the profit or loss percent on selling article 1. The cost price of article = 12500 rupees The marked price of the article = 12500 + 20% of 12500 = 12500 + 2500 = 15000 The discount allowed = 10% The discount = 10% of the marked price = 10% of 15000 = 1500 The selling price = 15000 – 1500 = 13500 The profit = 13500 – 12500 = 1000 rupees The profit percent = 1000 / 12500 * 100 = 8% profit

M: The cost price of article = 12500 rupees The marked price of the article = 12500 + 20% of 12500 = 12500 + 2500 = 15000 The discount allowed = 10% The discount = 10% of the marked price = 10% of 15000 = 1500 The selling price = 15000 – 1500 = 13500 Q: The cost price of article = 12200 rupees The marked price of the article = 12200 + 50% of 12200 = 12200 + 6100 = 18300 The discount allowed = 20% The discount = 20% of the marked price = 20% of 18300 = 3660 The selling price = 18300 – 3660 = 14640 rupees The average of m and q = (13500 + 14640) / 2 = 14070 rupees

Question 20 Marks for correct response: 1.00 Negative marking: 0.00 In a certain code “LION” is written as “MNHK”. How is “MONKEY” is written in that code? Marks awarded 0 Difficulty - Attempt% 60 Correct% 34 Your time 2 Avg time 143 Here, reverse the words and move -1 from its original position. i.e. for “LION” the reversed word is NOIL and the code is MNHK. Similarly, for “MONKEY” the reversed word is YEKNOM and the code is XDJMNL. Hence, the answer is XDJMNL.
